items.title: Working at the frontier: How Cognition trusts Claude Fable 5 to work through the night | Claude by Anthropic
items.summary_1line: Cognition tested Claude Fable 5 in Devin, its AI software engineer. It's the first model its team trusts to run unattended for eight hours and deliver production-ready code.
items.editor_note: First reported eight-hour unattended production run — Cognition's Devin trusts Fable 5 overnight, a new adoption high point since the Max-access narrowing report.

editorial.tldr: Anthropic launched Claude Fable 5 and the unguarded Mythos 5 in late June as long-horizon models "made safe for general use." A same-day companion post revealed a US export-control suspension had already been lifted, with a fresh redeploy starting July 1 alongside new cyber-safeguard classifiers and a first-draft jailbreak severity framework.
editorial.whats_new: Cognition says its Devin coding agent now trusts Claude Fable 5 to run unattended for eight hours and ship production-ready code — the first sign of deepening enterprise trust since the July 5 report that Claude Max access to the model was narrowing.
editorial.why_it_matters: An eight-hour unattended run at a production-grade bar is a concrete data point for anyone evaluating how far Fable 5 can be trusted on long-horizon agentic coding tasks without a human in the loop.
editorial.take_for_builders: If you're piloting long unattended agent runs, Cognition's eight-hour production-ready benchmark with Fable 5 is a useful reference point — but confirm your own access path (API, Bedrock, or Max-plan) hasn't hit the reported narrowing before depending on it for overnight jobs.

status.state: Enterprise trust deepening · Max-plan access still unresolved
status.detail: Fable 5 and Mythos 5 launched "made safe for general use" in late June with an export-control suspension already lifted; a July 5 hands-on report flagged Claude Max access narrowing, and Anthropic case studies since — a builder field guide, then Cognition's eight-hour unattended Devin run — show deepening enterprise trust without resolving the Max-plan access question.
